user.title: Connect to myEnergy
user.description: Use your myEnergy login. Automatic verification requires a dedicated IMAP mailbox that receives your codes.

mailbox.title: Verification mailbox
mailbox.description: Use a dedicated inbox. For Gmail, enter an app password without spaces. Codes are used only to complete login.

data.subject: Subject template (replace the six digits with {code})

otp.title: Email verification
otp.description: Enter the code just sent by myEnergy. It is used once and is not saved.

progress.login: Signing in and waiting for a fresh verification email. This can take up to two minutes.

error.invalid_auth: Login or verification failed. Check your credentials and start again.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect. Try again later.
error.mailbox_error: Unable to retrieve a fresh verification code. Check the mailbox settings or return to setup and choose manual verification.
error.unexpected_response: myEnergy returned an unexpected response. Check for an integration update.

abort.already_configured: This myEnergy account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: Use the same myEnergy account when reauthenticating.
